iteration_2_observations: All iteration-2 changes correctly reflected in with-skill responses: 6 phases, bundled POLICY.md, GitHub repo request prompt, self-reference skip logic.
The GitHub repo request early trigger appears naturally in evals 1 and 3 (where github_state is absent) and correctly does not appear in eval 2 (where github_state is has_content).
Self-reference skip logic works correctly: empty gitlab_self_references → item skipped in both manifest and response.
GPL-3.0 handling continues to work well with the human-action-required guard pattern.
Resume dashboard (eval 2) correctly shows 6 phases with proper formatting.
